docs.summary: Unified asset/scene selector modal. Provides a Scene tab (lists GameObjects and components from the current scene) and an Assets tab (lists project and built-in assets with thumbnails). Only one selector can be open at a time.

members.name: Open
members.signature: public static void Open(string title, Type targetType, SelectorTabs tabs, Action<object?> onSelect)

params.title: Modal title (e.g. "Select Mesh").
params.targetType: The type being selected (e.g. typeof(Transform), typeof(Mesh), typeof(Rigidbody3D)).
params.onSelect: Callback with the selected value, or null for "None".

docs.summary: Close the selector modal and clear the callback.
